purpose: Extend the pre-existing three-source common-target ledger with a fourth independently anchored, paper-derived human-plasma source without using model performance or outcome information for target selection.

target_definition.selection_rule: The frozen target set is the exact intersection of canonical accessions having rank_target_eligible=true and a finite strictly positive author value in every source after adding the PMC6592156 source to the frozen T192 source set.
target_definition.blank_zero_na_policy: Retain source blank, explicit zero and NA states; exclude them from rank eligibility; do not impute or infer non-detection.
target_definition.technical_replicate_policy: Retain every source coordinate and technical replicate in the ledger; do not count technical replicates as independent biological units.
target_definition.biological_independence_policy: Laboratory anchors are counted as distinct source lineages. Donor-level independence is reported per source and is not inferred from laboratory count or technical batches.

claim_boundary: This protocol admits a four-source, row-traceable, paper-derived development common-target asset. It improves source compatibility but does not establish four independent biological cohorts, primary lockbox evaluation, no-author reproduction, external adoption, DOI archival or scientific submission readiness.
